title: Improving the Inclusivity of Dutch Speech Recognition by Fine-tuning Whisper on the JASMIN-CGN Corpus

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of the Whisper speech recognition model across different age demographic groups, specifically focusing on children and the elderly versus adults.
Comparing the Word Error Rate (WER) of the Whisper speech recognition model on speech from native Dutch speakers versus non-native Dutch speakers (L2 learners).
